name: Deltans
summary: Deltans are intelligent, mammal-like natives of Delta Eridani 4 (Eden) with a stone-age tribal society. Predators had pushed them to the brink of extinction when Bob found them in 2165.
book2Notes: Population growth leads to gangs and a second village, Caerleon (2182).

name: Gorilloids
summary: Gorilloids are strong, ape-like pack predators on Eden that were hunting the Deltans toward extinction.

name: Hippogriffs
summary: Hippogriffs are large, flying, camouflaged apex predators on Eden, with toothed beaks. They drove the Deltans out of Camelot long ago.
book2Notes: Bob destroys their nesting archipelago with a ship buster (Jun 2172).
notes: A 'new predator' in book 1 ch. 53 is not clearly identified as a hippogriff; the name first appears in book 2 (ch. 17-19).

name: Raptors
summary: Raptors are intelligent pack-hunting theropod-like predators on Vulcan that attack the Landing colony from 2188.

name: Cupid bugs
summary: Cupid bugs are hummingbird-sized parasites on Vulcan that lay eggs under the skin. The larvae burrow into the host's heart.

name: The Others
summary: The Others are an alien species that harvests entire star systems for metal and food. Mario finds the first evidence of them at Beta Hydri (2169).
book2Notes: They are four-foot, many-eyed creatures with a vertical mouth.
They are building a Dyson sphere and see other sentient species as food.
They destroy Delta Pavonis (2217) and then target Sol and Epsilon Eridani.
notes: homeSystemId (GL 877) is only revealed in book 2. Book 1 has only their aftermath at Beta Hydri; whether the name 'the Others' is used in book 1 isn't confirmed.

name: Pav
summary: The Pav are meerkat-like intelligent natives of Delta Pavonis 4, at roughly a Victorian-era technology level with steam and coal. Jacques discovers them in 2207.
book2Notes: Phineas and Ferb rescue 20,000 Pav before the Others destroy the planet (2217).
